title: [PDF] Rapamycin (and rapalogs) - Alzheimer's Drug Discovery Foundation
abstract: Types of evidence: • 5 meta-analyses of adverse health effects of rapamycin/rapalog use in organ transplant/cancer • 1 meta-analysis of studies assessing musculoskeletal effects of rapamycin/rapalogs • 4 RCTs on short-term use for vaccine efficacy • 2 pilot studies of low dose rapamycin in healthy older adults 10 Last updated on January 29, 2025 • 1 pilot study of rapamycin in coronary artery disease • 1 observational study of off-label rapamycin use • 2 studies in non-human primates • 2 studies in client-owned dogs • Multiple mouse studies on lifespan Lifespan/Healthspan: BENEFIT IN ANIMAL MODELS BUT TRANSLATABILITY TO HUMANS REMAINS UNCLEAR Rapamycin extends lifespan in worms, flies, and mice. The Impacts of Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Inhibition on Aged Human Muscle (NCT05414292) study is a randomized, single-blind, placebo-controlled trial designed to assess the effects of rapamycin (Rapamune) at a dose of 1 mg/day for 16 weeks in combination with a 14 week unilateral resistance exercise training program in men (n=16) over age 50.
